prompt:
Follow-up in the same conversation:

Harden OpeningSession.mow against unbounded loop time. The current while(progress >= duration) loop can take impractical time for a finite but very large deltaSeconds or a very small valid positive baleMowingDurationSeconds. Replace the per-bale loop with constant-time quotient/remainder arithmetic while preserving existing normal behavior and remainder semantics. For results whose bale count or updated groundBaleCount cannot be represented exactly/safely by Dart int/double arithmetic, return false without mutating any state; do not add an arbitrary gameplay cap. Keep rejecting non-finite/non-positive deltas and preserve the current configurable duration contract. Add regression tests proving ordinary multi-bale calls still work, double.maxFinite and a tiny positive duration cannot hang or corrupt state, and failure leaves the entire state unchanged. Own only lib/game/domain/opening_session.dart and test/game/domain/opening_session_test.dart. Run focused opening_session tests, full flutter test, and flutter analyze. Preserve the first-planting anchor and all unrelated workspace changes. Do not commit or publish.
